sentences.text: 4. The FIR unfolds that the petitioner had induced the victim to have a physical relationship with him after a false promise of marriage but, the petitioner cheated the victim and did not marry her.
The victim was induced into believing the petitioner because he went to her house and proposed to marry her and he also had a discussion with the family members of the victim.

5. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the informant pressurized the petitioner to marry the victim and the petitioner sought time and promised that they would have married in the next year.
As the petitioner was delaying the marriage, the informant lodged a false case against the petitioner to compel him to marry her.
6. It is further submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is a Central Government employee and in the event of his arrest, he will be terminated from service.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged by the informant.
7. Annexure-1 is the identity card of the petitioner.
8. I have considered the submissions at the bar with circumspection.
9. There appears to be a prima facie case for interim bail.

In the interim and in the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be Page No.# 3/3 enlarged on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction arresting authority under the conditions that:
(i) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 20 (Twenty)
days and cooperate with the investigation.
(ii) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when called for, for the purpose of investigation.
12. List the matter on 17.07.2024.
